type:
∀ {σ : Type u_3} {R : Type u_4} [inst : CommSemiring R] (i : σ) (f : R[X]) (B : MvPolynomial σ R),
  (∀ e ∈ B.support, e i = 0) →
    ∀ (d : σ →₀ ℕ), ((Polynomial.aeval (X i)) f * B).coeff d = f.coeff (d i) * B.coeff (Finsupp.erase i d)
what: Computes the coefficient of the product of a univariate polynomial in one variable and a multivariate polynomial independent of that variable.
how: Expands Polynomial.eval₂_eq_sum and coeff_monomial_mul', then Finset.sum_eq_single selects the only possible univariate exponent; the support-independence hypothesis kills every other summand.
hypotheses: Arbitrary variable type and commutative semiring; second factor has zero selected-coordinate exponent throughout its support. No finiteness or nonzero assumptions.
caller_summary: One explicit caller, private coeff_taylor_monomial_single_add_aux at Taylor115; no explicit outside-file references. Full caller replay uses fresh target replay.
mathlib_api_audit: Private coefficient-convolution reduction using polynomial evaluation sum and coeff_monomial_mul′; no public contribution verdict inferred.
moral_duplications: One implementation and one direct caller; isolates the support-independent coefficient extraction, not the full Hasse/Taylor theorem.
generalization: Already arbitrary variables/commutative semiring, f,B,d; no successful weakening proposed. hB is the coordinate-independence premise used to discard other summands.
missing_api: No missing primitive blocks existing proof; public extraction API suitability is unassessed under private prefilter.
junk: Retain private helper; useful boundary in monomial-induction proof. No sorry, resource raise, TODO or excessive proof size.
